decisive_items: a large right retroperitoneal predominantly fatty mass in the location of the right adrenal gland
response.rationale: The patient's imaging studies show a large, fatty mass in the location of the right adrenal gland, which is consistent with adrenal myelolipoma. The presence of internal areas of soft-tissue density is also consistent with this diagnosis.

rejected.why: Lipoma is less likely due to the presence of internal areas of soft-tissue density, which is not typical of lipoma.
